Description

Location: 371 Commonwealth Avenue, Back Bay, Boston, MA  
Phone: 617-517-5915 | Hours: Sun-Thu 5pm–9:30pm, Fri 5pm–10pm, Sat 5pm–10:30pm

The Vibe & Atmosphere

- Chic elegance without stuffiness.Glamorous chandelier-lit dining room that feels special-occasion-worthy but genuinely welcoming.
- Forbes 4-Star rated (retained since 2017); "Best French Restaurant" winner from Boston Magazine multiple times (2014, 2017, 2023, 2025)
- Warm lighting and cream-colored palette with marble & stone accents; windows overlook Commonwealth and Massachusetts Avenues
- Heated outdoor patio (perfect in season); fireplace in main dining room
- Unique feature: wall of mirrors reflecting Back Bay skyline
- Beautiful windows framing historic Back Bay architecture

The Crowd

- Special occasion diners (celebrations, anniversaries, round-number birthdays)
- Date night couples seeking romance
- Boston's top chefs (professional endorsement—they dine here)
- Upscale but not pretentious clientele
- Mixed business/leisure crowds

What Diners Rave About

Best Dishes (from reviews):

- Duck Confit — Signature dish; crispy exterior, melting meat, often with lentils and Port reduction
- Roast Duck — Pistachio-crusted or traditional; called "best duck in the city"
- Foie Gras — Luxurious preparations; sometimes paired with prunes soaked in Port
- Roast Chicken — Perfectly executed French classic
- Crème Brûlée — Coconut version with orange sorbet receives particular praise
- Lobster Bisque — Elegant French preparation
- Prime Beef Tartare & Wagyu Carpaccio — Described as "ambitious appetizers"

Wine Program (Major Strength)

- 630 selections from 2,600-bottle inventory
- Wine Spectator Award of Excellence(since 2015)
- Sommelier Nick Daddona (10+ years experience) curates exceptional pairings
- Specialties: French Burgundy, Bordeaux, Rhône, Bordeaux, Italy, California
- Many bottles under 50;extensive50;extensive100+ selection
- World-class wine program—described as one of Boston's best

Service

- Consistently praised as "impeccable," "attentive," and "solicitous"
- Friendly yet professional tone
- Knowledgeable staff about dishes and wine pairings
- Responsive to special occasions

Dress Code

- Casual-but-smart to dressy evening wear
- Upscale atmosphere suggests something trendier than business casual

What Reviewers Say

"Exquisite, nouvelle French–inflected cuisine to linger over, beautifully served in a sexy space with a cool bar." — Zagat

"Glamorous, chandelier-lit dining room creates special-occasion-feel, but there isn't a hint of stuffiness thanks to friendly vibe." — Time Out

"That rare American with a perfect French accent." — Boston Magazine (2025)

To Maximize Your Experience at Deuxave

1. Reserve in advance (8+ parties book via OpenTable as "Experiences"; 13+ via info@deuxave.com)
2. Ask for wine pairing recommendations — the sommelier is a major asset
3. Mention occasion — special attention to celebrations/dates
4. Try the seasonal tasting menu (145,addfoiegrassupplementfor 145,addfoiegrassupplementfor 30)
5. Arrive dressed elegantly — the beautiful room invites sophistication
6. Dine in shoulder seasons (spring/early fall) for patio access
7. Consider the duck confit or roast duck as signature dishes
